program_narrative: Program TSTGEN00 is a batch test-data generator that ends with GOBACK. It opens the configuration file TEST-CONFIG and the seed file RANDOM-SEED for input and the output files PORTFOLIO-OUT and TRANSACTION-OUT, reads one seed value into WS-RANDOM-SEED and clears its counters. The main loop reads TEST-CONFIG until end of file and, for each configuration record, selects the generator by CFG-TEST-TYPE: portfolio data ('PORTFOLIO'), transaction data ('TRANSACTN'), error data ('ERROR') or volume data ('VOLUME'). The portfolio and transaction generators loop CFG-VOLUME times, but every paragraph they and the error/volume generators perform (2210, 2220, 2310, 2320, 2410, 2420, 2510, 2520) is not present in the program, so the actual record generation and writing cannot be traced. Error conditions handled: a failed OPEN of any of the four files and an unrecognised test type; each displays WS-ERROR-MESSAGE (a name not declared in the program or its copybooks), counts the error and continues, and the program stops with return code 12 only after more than 100 errors.
